name: Bounce Kiyovu
geoNote: 16 KN 47 Street pin (Baso café adjacent — same civic address as club listings)
description: Bounce Kiyovu is a Kigali padel and tennis address on KN 47 Street in Kiyovu, with published phone and app booking. A clear recommendation when you want a named Rwanda padel stop in the city centre rather than an informal court. Confirm padel court availability and open play before you go — coaching and junior clinics are also listed.
sourceTypes: Bounce club page; Padel Lands Rwanda
researchNotes: Other Kigali venues (e.g. Mamba) noted in travel blogs but not double-sourced within this audit pass

name: Mamba Sport Padel
seasonNote: Venue hours commonly listed 11:00–23:00; padel via PlaybyPoint.
description: Mamba Sport Padel is a Kimihurura Kigali padel offering at the Mamba entertainment hub on KG 680 Street with published phone and PlaybyPoint booking. A clear second Kigali recommendation beyond Bounce Kiyovu when you want Kimihurura courts beside Tugende cafe. Book on PlaybyPoint or call ahead.
sourceTypes: Scribs and Nibs Kigali sports guide (2 courts + PlaybyPoint); VibeKigali listing (KG 680 St + phone)
researchNotes: FIND tick 2026-09-25. Phone may be venue desk not padel-only. Alternate +250 780 303 463 also published for Mamba Club — primary VibeKigali 786 used. Distinct from RWA-VEN-001 Bounce.

name: The Pinnacle Kigali Padel
geoNote: KK 30 Avenue Nyanza / Kicukiro street pin
seasonNote: Members club / hotel sports; book padel via The Pinnacle Kigali sports app (TPC Matchpoint) or call reservations.
description: The Pinnacle Kigali lists padel among its club sports on KK 30 Avenue in Rebero with a published reservations phone and email plus a dedicated sports booking app. A clear third Kigali recommendation beyond Bounce Kiyovu and Mamba Kimihurura when you want Rebero courts.
